spec.title: application-core values V2 step 1: the conformance corpus under --engine auto and auto --confirm, now that the own checker runs the immutable-list models
spec.description: Values stream of llm-dlc/loops/application-core.md (llm-dlc/loops/application-core-values.md, V2 step 1, acceptance row V2), at the commit that submits this job. The tool's own checker (lib/src/bmc) now runs lib/models' List.of/List.copyOf and ImmutableCollections bytecode (models::CHECKER_RUNS), which it met as the gap jdk-static-method before. Inline, lib/tests/conformance.rs's own-checker test passes with 12 list claims of the corpus now decided natively, each as the JVM decides it (listSizes, listNull, listChange, listCopySame, listGet proved and refuted; listCopyMutable's and listOfArray's refutations). This job runs the two ignored corpus tests that need JBMC: under --engine jbmc and --engine auto (auto now takes the native verdict on those claims instead of falling back to JBMC), and under auto --confirm (JBMC is now asked to confirm the own checker's new list proofs, on JBMC's class path with the same models). Domain and bounds: the corpus's, unchanged (int parameters, the claims' assumptions, unwind 16). Engine: jbmc, native via auto. Expected verdicts: no Verified the JVM refutes, every violation reproduced on the JVM; under --confirm a proof of the own checker's is Confirmed or NotAsked, never Disagreed where the JVM agrees with it. Expected process status: exit 0 for both steps. matchesExpected is the tests passing; a failure lists each disagreement, a finding to triage, not to retry.
